problem: The non-applicable branch negates an applicability property shape that includes sh:datatype xsd:boolean. If shipOperatesInPolarWaters contains an explicit xsd:boolean true together with any non-boolean value, that property shape fails and sh:not succeeds, allowing the candidate to bypass all three mandatory document-coverage checks even though applicability is explicitly true.
required_change: Make the negated applicability test detect the presence of an xsd:boolean true value without requiring every value to satisfy the datatype constraint, for example by removing sh:datatype and sh:minCount from the nested test while retaining datatype validation in the applicable branch.
regression_guard: Preserve target class nltl:ship and require all three document-coverage indicators to be explicitly true whenever an xsd:boolean true shipOperatesInPolarWaters value is present.
